title: mcp/pack unattended capability pack
description: Unattended-task capability pack (governance dataset org.evorule.mcp.packs, standing delegation). Strict builtin: task_ref, servers (canonical blake3 server_key subset of the approval list), ttl_secs and on_gap (the only legal value is "block" - the design provides no improvise form) are required; budget_secs is an optional declaration consumed by the existing wall-clock budget mechanism. entry_id convention = task_ref; re-issuing a pack bumps the entry version. The executor intersects this pack with the approval list at spawn time (pack AND list).
